panels.description: In a rented Halyard workroom, Lina, Suri, Jalen and Ren place four components around a cloudy Keel water sample. Keep each maker distinct and leave upper bench space.
Lina tests the sample and rejects a membrane while Alex watches. Leave upper bench space.
The components fail to communicate; the prototype shudders and the readout drops to eleven percent. Leave upper machine space.
Ren studies the failed connector while the others look at the machine, each taking in a different problem. Leave upper room space.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Keel has water now. It can’t use it.

items.speaker: LINA
items.text: Not that one. It lies under heat.

items.speaker: REN
items.text: Good. Now we know where it breaks.
